name: Soul Sleep
overview: The doctrine of Soul Sleep is grounded in Scripture's depiction of death as a state of unconsciousness or inactivity until resurrection. Psalms 6:5 and 115:17 emphasize that the dead do not praise or remember the Lord, while Ecclesiastes 9:5 affirms that the dead know nothing and have no further reward. Ecclesiastes 12:7 highlights the return of the spirit to God, and Daniel 12:2 promises a future awakening from the dust of the earth to either everlasting life or judgment. Together, these verses portray death as a temporary sleep until God calls the dead to resurrection.
